title: Clear The Name
style: 84 bpm slow burn blues rock, dirty Telecaster guitar, Hammond B3 organ, upright bass, brushed snare drums, smoky male blues lead, female smoky harmony, late night roadhouse, dynamic build
lyrics:
[Intro - dirty Tele, organ swell, brushes]
(spoken, low, male)
some names get dirty in the wash.
some names get dirty in the rinse.
some names get dirty because somebody wanted them dirty.
this song is for the third kind.

[Verse 1 - smoky male blues lead]
i didn't say what they say i said
i didn't do what they say i did
but the room had already made up its mind
before i walked in, before i sat

so i sat down quiet and i let them talk
because sometimes silence is the loudest walk
and the truth, when it's ready, will find its own road
and the lie, when it's tired, will drop its own load

[Pre-Chorus - organ rises, female harmony enters]
clear the name, clear the name
not for revenge, not for blame
clear the name so the work stays clean
clear the name so the kids can lean
on something true when they need to know
that the man they came from didn't bend low

[Chorus - full band, smoky duet]
clear the name, clear the name
the slow burn truth is the one that came
through the smoke and through the rain
clear the name, clear the name
clear the name, clear the name
the long road home is the only train
that carries men back from this kind of stain
clear the name

[Verse 2 - male, slightly fuller, dirtier guitar]
i got the receipts and i got the dates
i got the messages and the postal weights
i got the witnesses who said the same thing
in the rooms where they thought no microphone would ring

but i ain't gonna throw it like a knife at the wall
i'm gonna lay it on the table for the long haul
because the cheap clear is the clear that don't last
the slow clear is the clear that finally outlasts the cast
of the lie

[Chorus]
clear the name, clear the name
the slow burn truth is the one that came
through the smoke and through the rain
clear the name, clear the name
clear the name, clear the name
the long road home is the only train
that carries men back from this kind of stain
clear the name

[Bridge - guitar solo, dirty Tele, two passes, organ huge]
(no vocal)

[Verse 3 - male, quietest, female harmony close]
so if you're sitting in a room where they made up their mind
don't argue, don't beg, don't try to be kind
just go home and write down everything that's true
and wait for the slow burn to do what slow burns do

[Final Chorus - biggest, organ full, dirty Tele wails]
clear the name, clear the name
the slow burn truth is the one that came
through the smoke and through the rain
clear the name, clear the name
clear the name, clear the name
the long road home is the only train
that carries men back from this kind of stain
clear the name
clear the name

[Outro - guitar tail, organ fade, spoken]
the slow burn always wins.
the slow burn always wins.
hold the line.
